top_comments.body:
I'm also seeing this on Windows.

Claude Code for Windows v1.7196.0.0
Opus 4.7 → 400 role 'system' is not supported on this model
Opus 4.6 → works
CLI v2.1.148 with same model → works
Reproduces even from a clean directory with no project context

top_comments.body: I had the same issue on cli v2.1.140, it works fine after upgrading to v2.1.142
